candidate_facts.text: The Korean War was triggered by the invasion of South Korea by North Korean forces on June 25, 1950.
North Korean forces crossed the 38th parallel during the invasion of South Korea on June 25, 1950.
The North Korean People's Army (NKPA) carried out the invasion of South Korea on June 25, 1950.
The North Korean attack on June 25, 1950, was a surprise invasion.
The North Korean attack quickly captured Seoul, the capital of South Korea.
